title: Prominence "Rose on 30A" 106 East Milestone Drive Unit C
h1: Prominence "Rose on 30A" 106 East Milestone Drive Unit C
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Remodeled in 2025- Close proximity to the beach- Walking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly Entertainment- 2 Large Community Pools and Barbecue Areas - Fitness Facility- 2 Adult bikes- Parking for 2 vehicle- Garage- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Happiness blooms at Rose on 30A, a beautiful 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom Prominence townhome that sleeps 6 guests. Neighboring Deer Lake State Park offers exciting days of hiking, birdwatching, and exploring the area’s rare coastal dune lakes. Take advantage of the 2 community pools and barbecue areas for warm-weather fun, or walk over to The Big Chill for shopping, dining, and entertainment! Guests will love this home’s peaceful porch—the ultimate spot to start each morning with a fragrant cup of coffee.The first level of this 2-story property welcomes guests with crisp white wainscoting and a classic staircase leading to the main floor.Ascend to find a spacious living and dining space accented with shades of blush, blue, and beige for cheerful warmth, while dark hardwood floors and a 10-foot tray ceiling invoke a sense of elevated elegance. Artful chairs and a beach rattan pendant light add a playful atmosphere to group meals at the 6-seat dining table. In the open living space, a plush L-shaped couch and cozy armchair beckon guests for a comfortable night watching TV or swapping stories over glasses of chilled white wine. The modern kitchen is seamlessly connected and features polished countertops, high-end appliances, and a breakfast bar for 4. Double glass doors off the living and dining area lead onto a covered, screened-in porch with cushioned patio seating and a drinks’ table, perfect for unwinding with a book in the gentle breeze. Flanking the great room are the inviting sleeping accommodations, including a tranquil primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom, and a light-filled bunk room with a queen-over-queen bunk bed and balcony access. An in-unit washer and dryer add convenience.Discover a delightful beach getaway at Rose on 30A in Prominence. Guests have everything they need for a convenient vacation, with parking for 2 vehicle and 2 complimentary adult bikes. Beach access is a short drive or ride away at Walton Dunes or Deer Creek Beach Access on Deer Lake State Park. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 6):SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo** The community north pool is heated, seasonally, during fall and early spring.*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
